verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a flag platform is a fair question for a feature-flag product, but the evidence pack never documents an open-source distribution or a self-hosted deployment of Statsig. Warehouse Native runs analysis in your own warehouse, and the SDKs evaluate flags locally without a network request. Both are adjacent features, not a self-hosted full flag platform, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure
